## Interpretation

Identical topology is NOT required. AccuTile's floating-point accumulation-order differences can cause small densification-threshold crossing differences, leading to slightly different clone/split/prune counts and final N_GS. The question is whether topology divergence is systematic (indicating a real semantic change) or random FP-scale (consistent with an exact conservative optimization).
